Usage: tripo task get [options] <task-id>

fetch one task (accepts @last/@name)

Options:
  --step            include pipeline step details
  --download        download artifacts if successful
  -o, --out <dir>   output directory for --download
  --json            machine-readable output on stdout
  --yes             skip confirmations
  --quiet           suppress progress logs on stderr
  --no-open         never auto-open the browser/viewer
  --profile <name>  use a named account profile
  -h, --help        display help for command
